saved_geometry_facts.saved_edge_pair_semantics: Unique sorted undirected node pairs; not normals, orientation or owners. Right-face normal is a geometric inference from fixed square bounds and saved coordinates; original face-ray observer exports only bottom/left.

reference_mesh_basis.owner_validation_scope: These are static expected owners from the actual declared grid, saved body cell-ID list and production connectivity formula. No model array decoded and no actual owner/phase table calculated. Future thin caller must require each physical edge has one body and one non-body owning cell, the stated local edge, matching reference coordinates/points, and record original saved solid/medium mask. These are interface consistency checks, not a new physical qualification.
reference_mesh_basis.cut_scope: 36 top edges y=40 are the lower-half symmetry cut; excluded from 72 physical edges. The cut is at the domain boundary, so do not invent an exterior cell or mirror stress for this diagnostic.
reference_mesh_basis.corner_scope: Two face samples at the same corner can have different exterior cell owners and normals; retain both records. Do not average neighbouring P at an endpoint or assign the nodal corner weak force to one face. Corner-touching diagonal cells belong to the nodal support, not an edge owner.

quadrature_basis.point_order: xi varies slowly, eta quickly, as written in tmc_kernel.py:57. Edge quadrature is already present in the saved nine-point stress array; it is not an interior-only Gauss rule.
quadrature_basis.independent_line_weight_formula: reference_edge_length_mm * [1,4,1] / 6; multiply thickness_mm=20 once for force integration
quadrature_basis.nominal_stress_units: P @ N_body is nominal material traction in MPa; it is not yet an integrated N vector.
quadrature_basis.volume_weights_warning: The model.ops nine-point weights are area Jacobian times thickness (hx*hy*t/36 tensor [1,4,1] outer [1,4,1]); never reuse them as boundary line weights or multiply already-thick volume force weights by thickness again.
quadrature_basis.estimate_scope: Independent edge Simpson line estimate of the saved nominal material traction. No claim of exact continuous stress integration or total traction/pressure qualification.

sign_and_stress_basis.P_scope: Saved stress_first_piola is rounded float64 constitutive material P, including original solid/medium Lamé scaling, with no Hu regularization contribution and no thickness factor.
sign_and_stress_basis.body_side_traction: t_material_on_body = P_exterior @ N_body,outward. This is the transmitted material-stress diagnostic; sign follows Cauchy traction convention. Exterior-cell outward normal at the common edge is -N_body, so the exterior cell edge traction P@N_exterior has opposite sign.
sign_and_stress_basis.compression_scalar: signed_nominal_material_compression_MPa = -N_body dot (P_exterior @ N_body). Positive represents compressive material normal traction by this convention, negative represents tensile material normal traction; no clipping.
sign_and_stress_basis.shear_scalar: signed_nominal_material_shear_MPa = T dot (P_exterior @ N_body), with T explicitly taken along the positive sampling direction in face_specs. Thus bottom T=(1,0), left/right T=(0,1); this is not a single oriented closed-boundary tangent convention.
sign_and_stress_basis.bottom_sign_example: N_body=(0,-1): t=(-P_xy,-P_yy); material P_yy<0 would give upward body force, positive signed compression. This is an algebraic convention, not a computed P sign at either saved state.
sign_and_stress_basis.weak_force_sign_source: workpiece_nodal.py:17 and53: existing body nodal weak force equals minus saved global internal force; holding reaction is opposite. No new weak sum required.
sign_and_stress_basis.fixed_overlay_note: All incident body DOFs are fixed. The selected saved descriptors report F-I=0,J-1=0,Hu=0,first-Piola=0 inside the overlay. These interior zeros do not describe exterior traction or establish zero contact/holding force.
sign_and_stress_basis.no_total_pressure: Negative Hu nodal/category weak force is not tensile contact pressure. Material P@N is not total Hu-including pressure, Cauchy stress, current-area stress, pointwise nonpenetration or effective-gripping qualification.

weak_vs_trace_relation.existing_weak_definition: The saved material weak resultant is -the global material internal force projected onto all fixed body node DOFs. Its test function is the Q1 sum of body nodal basis functions, supported beyond the body cells into neighbouring and corner-diagonal cells.
why_no_identity_gate: A raw physical-edge P_exterior@N_body trace integral is a surface diagnostic; the Q1 nodal projection contains volume contractions with basis gradients over the entire nodal support.

Integration by parts relates them only with weighted element volume-divergence terms and interelement stress jumps; assembled discrete free-node equilibrium does not imply pointwise div(P)=0 or stress-continuous interfaces.
Body-corner nodal support includes diagonal cells touching at a point; these have no physical edge ownership and cannot be collapsed into a single face pressure sample.

The original nine-point volume weak-force quadrature and the independent three-point edge Simpson estimate are distinct numerical functionals of a nonlinear saved P field. Their difference is descriptive evidence, not an automatically valid defect or error estimate.
Shared edge endpoints and stress traces are retained per exterior owner; no smoothing, forced redistribution or missing Hu correction is silently used.
weak_vs_trace_relation.proposed_report: Place material trace edge/side/whole estimates beside the existing saved material weak resultants and signed differences. Do not compare material trace against total force as if Hu were absent; do not impose equality, relative-percent near-zero or a fresh scientific pass threshold.
